standard_prerequisites.name: Computing RF on acyclics
standard_prerequisites.use: RGamma via any complex of acyclics.

core_obligations: Hom(j_!O_U, F) = F(U) (Sheaves, Lemma j-shriek-modules), so Hom(j_!O_U,K) = RGamma(U,K) in the derived category; the goal becomes RGamma(U,-) commuting with direct sums (proof lines 13701-13706).
Assumption (1) gives finite cohomological dimension of H^0(U,-); assumption (2) makes any direct sum of injectives acyclic for it (proof lines 13707-13710).

Choose K-injective representatives I_i^* with injective terms;  oplus K_i is represented by  oplus I_i^* (Injectives, Lemma derived-products), and computing RF on complexes of acyclics (Derived Categories, Lemma unbounded-right-derived) gives RGamma(U,  oplus K_i) represented by  oplus H^0(U,I_i^*), whence the commutation with direct sums (proof lines 13711-13721).
proof_roadmap: Use finite cohomological dimension and acyclicity of sums of injectives.
difficulty_reason: The proof identifies Hom(j_!O_U,-) with RGamma(U,-), notes finite cohomological dimension from (1) and acyclicity of direct sums of injectives from (2), and computes RGamma(U,  oplus K_i) on K-injective representatives with injective terms.
